call_points.text: Consolidated order book stands at ₹855 crore as of September 30, up over 700% year-on-year.
Gross margin seen at 65% as a sustainable blended number for the year.
Gross block by FY27-end expected to roughly double, mainly from the Saudi JV investment.
About US$10 million to be infused into the Saudi JV this month.
165 FAIs completed in the quarter; engagement started with six additional prospective customers.
FACC Austria agreement initial value USD 7.5 million over five years; marks entry into recurring aerospace component supplies.
US tariff impact cannot be quantified; FTWZ and European/Saudi footprint are the mitigants.
Dheya, the Saudi JV with Kanoo, is looking to raise about USD 10 million; Unimech may see modest dilution but keeps exclusive manufacturing.
Order book as of May 2026 stood at approximately ₹314 Cr on a consolidated basis including Hobel.
Expect FY27 to be a year of stronger growth and improved operating leverage compared to the previous year.

operating_notes.text: Target Hobel Bellows Co. recorded revenues of ₹100.99 Cr in FY24, ₹117.25 Cr in FY25, and ₹123.74 Cr in FY26.
Hobel Bellows reported provisional revenues of ₹123.7 Cr for FY26 with ~90% export-oriented business.
Hobel Bellows reported ~₹129 Cr revenue for FY26 with EBITDA margins exceeding 50% and 50-60% capacity utilization.
Monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26 reported ₹96.70 Cr unutilised IPO proceeds out of ₹250 Cr total issue size.
Order book stands at approximately ₹314 Cr on a consolidated basis including Hobel as of May 2026.
Hobel Bellows contributed ₹22 Cr over two months and 21% of Q1FY27 revenue.
Nuclear cumulative order wins about ₹87 Cr, with execution in H2FY27 and partly next year.
Capacity utilisation 58%, with nearly 10% of capacity committed to NPI and qualification programs.
Executed a 10-year LTA with Honeywell Aerospace US LLC for precision components and assemblies for aero-engine and control system applications.
Subsequent to Q2, invested ₹39.36 Cr for a 51% stake in Kanoo Unimech Advanced Manufacturing Solutions, Saudi Arabia.
H1FY27 revenue reached ₹230.62 Cr, up 85% YoY, driven by strong demand execution and Hobel Bellows consolidation.
Acquiring 76% (6,080,000 shares) of Hobel Bellows Private Limited at ₹10/share from subsidiary Innomech for ₹6.08 Cr.
Order book stood at ₹855 crore as of September 30, 2026, up over 700% YoY.

timeline.summary: Unimech Aerospace approved up to ₹450 Cr investment to acquire Hobel Bellows Co. via SPV Hobel Bellows Private Limited.
Unimech Aerospace signed definitive agreements to acquire Hobel Bellows, a Visakhapatnam-based manufacturer with ₹123.7 Cr provisional FY26 revenue.
Unimech Aerospace completed the acquisition of Hobel Bellows Private Limited with 24% direct and 76% indirect ownership.
Unimech Aerospace incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Uniflux Renewable Energy Private Limited, on April 27, 2026.
Unimech Aerospace hosted an investor call on April 28, 2026, discussing the strategic rationale and financial profile of the Hobel Bellows acquisition.
Unimech Aerospace released its monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26 showing ₹96.70 Cr unutilised IPO proceeds.
Unimech Aerospace filed its statement of deviation or variation in fund utilization for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹81.8 Cr (+19.6% YoY), net profit ₹26.1 Cr (-10.6% YoY).
Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited hosted an earnings call on May 29, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 results, with recording available at its website.
Unimech reported Q4 FY26 net revenue of ₹82 Cr and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹240 Cr during its earnings call on May 29, 2026.

On 4 August 2026 Unimech held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting first consolidated revenue of about ₹108 Cr (up 71% YoY) with Hobel Bellows contributing ₹22 Cr over two months, an order book of about ₹280 Cr and FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 34-35%.
Unimech's subsidiary Innomech executed a 10-year LTA with Honeywell Aerospace for precision components and assemblies.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹123 Cr (+98.5% YoY), net profit ₹31.77 Cr (+102.7% YoY).
Unimech reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹230.62 Cr (up 85% YoY) and PAT of ₹59.64 Cr, with an order book of ₹855 Cr.
Audio recording of earnings call held October 28, 2026 is available on the company website.
Unimech announced the acquisition of the remaining 76% stake in Hobel Bellows Private Limited from subsidiary Innomech for ₹6.08 Cr to simplify holding structure.
On October 28, 2026, Unimech hosted its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting revenue of ₹231 Cr for H1 and an order book of ₹855 Cr.
